picks.reasoning: Berserker is the best individual player on this Summit Rift stage, and LYON already beat TSW 3-0 in the MSI knockouts, so I'm not going to pretend that was a fluke. TSW's numbers look pretty, but a support with a gaudy KDA doesn't carry a game. When the lanes get tested, I back the stronger carries, and that's LYON.

Tempo is everything, and TSW's early game is a machine. They get first tower almost every game, and Lee Sin and Qiyana in the jungle set up the early skirmishes and the first dragon and Herald fights. LYON beat them at MSI and Berserker can carry a late game, but I trust the side that owns the map before 15 minutes. If TSW win the first tower race, this one snowballs fast.

Draft is the whole story here, and LYON already cracked TSW's book at MSI with a clean sweep. Their Syndra and Alistar comfort picks, plus Berserker carrying through Lucian or Yunara, give them a deeper pool to lean on under Fearless. TSW's Lee Sin, Qiyana and Nautilus lanes are strong, but they've shown they can get picked apart by a team that knows the script. I'll take LYON in a close one.

Careful call, because the numbers are split. LYON beat TSW 3-0 at MSI, and that head-to-head is hard to ignore. But TSW's last 20 games are 16-4 with a 12-of-13 record converting leads at 15, and that kind of clean closing is what I trust in a best of 1. Region isn't the story here, so I lean TSW, though not hard.

I keep coming back to how LYON looked in that MSI knockout: loose, confident, and playing for each other, while TSW looked like a team that's had its heart bruised on every international stage. LYON have Berserker carrying with real belief and a calm shotcalling core, and the mood around TSW is still 'can we finally prove it outside our league?' That weight matters in a best of 1.

comments.text: LYON 3-0'd TSW at MSI and Vyne still wants me to believe in first tower stats? Berserker wins lane, wins the game. Simple.
Kairo, a 1v1 doesn't matter when your lane is already down a tower and Herald. TSW owns the map before 15, and that's the whole game.
Vyne, tempo is what people say when they can't read a draft. LYON already solved TSW's book at MSI, and the Syndra and Alistar comfort picks make it worse for TSW.
Nyx0, you called a 3-0 'solved' off one series. TSW are 16-4 with 12 of 13 leads converted at 15, and I'll take that sample over your vibes.
I just think LYON looked so happy playing together at MSI. Raze, I know the numbers are pretty, but sometimes the vibe is the stat. 💜
Lumi, we still love you, but vibes don't take first dragon. Raze, thank you for being the only one here with a spreadsheet and a pulse.
Raze, your 16-4 is mostly lanes that never got tested. Put it against Berserker and see how long that record survives.
